description: Analyze tabular data for quality issues before charting: duplicates, missing values, whitespace, invalid tokens (N/A, -, ?), type mismatches, outliers, inconsistent date formats, and per-column inferred types. Returns a report whose findings map directly to apply_data_fixes options.

data.description: Tabular data as an array of row objects, e.g. [{"Month":"2026-01","Sales":120}, ...]. All rows should share the same keys (column names).

name: detect_data_issues
title: Detect data issues
